subject: The one thing 90% of users skip
preview_text: I just discovered a hidden feature that could save your date nights. You won't believe what changed.
body_paragraphs: I'm just going to say it—I made a mistake. I thought our app was perfect, but I was wrong. Turns out, we buried something so good that most of you never even saw it. And now I'm scared you'll miss out on the one thing that could actually fix that 'same old dinner and a movie' rut.

Here's the truth: couples who use this feature plan 3x more surprising dates. They stop guessing what their partner wants and start actually enjoying the process. It's not about more effort—it's about smarter effort. And since you last opened SoulPlan, we quietly upgraded this feature with new local spots and budget options you haven't seen yet.

I'm talking about the Surprise Date Planner. You pick the vibe and budget, we handle the rest. Your partner gets a notification that a date is coming, but they have no idea what it is. It builds anticipation, sparks curiosity, and makes you look like a hero without the stress. And now, with our latest update, it scans over 200 new venues and activities near you.

Open the app right now and tap 'Surprise Date Planner.' Plan one surprise date this week. That's it. One date that shows you care. P.S. The first couple to use it this week gets a free date night upgrade—details inside the app.
cta_text: Open SoulPlan and Plan a Surprise
